remarks:
Welcome to Lotus Bay Estate, an extraordinary Lake Erie offering combining 6–7 Lotus Bay Road (approximately 4.7 acres with two single family homes) and 3 Lake Shore Road (approximately 56.1 acres) for a combined 60.8± acres and an incredible 1,765 linear feet of Lake Erie frontage.

The 4.7 acre Lotus Bay Road property features two residences. 6 Lotus Bay Road is a 3 bedroom, 2 bath home with a spacious lake-facing primary suite, private porch, and large screened in porch overlooking Lake Erie. 7 Lotus Bay Road is a 2 bedroom, 1 bath home. Both residences have been successfully utilized as short-term rentals, offering immediate income-producing potential.

Adjoining the residences is 3 Lake Shore Road, a remarkable 56.1 acre parcel featuring extensive Lake Erie frontage, dramatic bluffs, wooded areas, open acreage, and breathtaking natural beauty. More than 11 acres are located across Lake Shore Road, adding flexibility and potential to the offering.

Together, these properties create a truly rare Lake Erie opportunity: an expansive waterfront estate with two existing income-producing homes and substantial additional acreage. The property offers tremendous potential for a private estate, multigenerational compound, recreational retreat, investment opportunity, or future development, subject to municipal approvals and applicable regulations.

Sale includes two separate parcels: Multi-family home MLS #B1709418 adjacent vacant lot MLS#B1705734,  being sold together as a package deal.

Sale includes two separate parcels: Multi-family home SBL #[142889-265-040-0001-050-100] AND adjacent vacant lot SBL #[142889-265-000-0002-041-000] being sold together as a package deal.
